build_hrnet_backbone: build an HRNet backbone model with configurable stages for high-resolution feature extraction
create_hrmodule: create an HRModule with multi-branch fusion layers for parallel high-resolution processing
build_transition_layer: build a transition layer to adapt channels between HRNet stages with different branch counts
run_hrnet_forward: run the HRNet forward pass to get multi-scale feature maps from input images
configure_hrnet_stages: configure HRNet stage parameters including num_branches, num_blocks, and num_channels per stage
